title: Vascular graft surveillance and transplant workup for the general surgeon

steps.tx: **Workup** (**cardiac** stress echo gates listing, **infection** screens clear fevers, **cancer** hunts hidden tumours, **sensitisation** crossmatch guards, **iliac** calcium maps landing, **urine** cultures clear bladders, **consent** voluntary choice counsels, **registry** NOTTO lists fairly) with **clears** (**bloods** antibodies screens, **scans** chests abdomens) vets; **list** (fit recipients only) registers. Candidates vet.
steps.say: Listing needs cardiac fitness with infection, cancer and sensitisation screens plus iliac maps, voluntary consent and fair registry places. Lists vet.

steps.tx: **Donation** (**brain-death** repeated exams apnea tests, **THOTA** Indian rules certify, **consent** family grief counsels, **retrieval** cold perfusion flushes, **ischaemia** cold time shrinks, **allocation** sickest fairest shares, **living** donors volunteer fit, **NOTTO** networks match) with **cools** (**flushes** organs chill, **boxes** ice travels) preserves; **share** (one donor many) multiplies. steps.say: Brain-death exams with apnea tests certify donors under Indian rules while cold perfusion with short cold times preserves organs for fair sharing. Cooling shares.

steps.tx: **Surveillance** (**duplex** vein grafts patrol, **stenosis** velocity steps flag, **angioplasty** threatened grafts rescues, **occlusion** silent kills, **prosthetic** ankle pressures track, **wounds** groins watch, **smoking** quitting protects, **antiplatelet** classes guard) with **patrols** (**velocities** ratios maps, **pressures** ankles trends) guards; **rescue** (stenoses before clots) saves. Grafts patrol.
steps.say: Vein grafts earn duplex patrols where velocity steps flag stenoses for angioplasty before silent occlusion, guarded by quitting with antiplatelet classes. Patrols rescue.

steps.tx: **Infection** (**fever** draining sinuses warn, **excision** infected prosthesis removes, **extra-anatomic** clean planes reroute, **autograft** vein resists better, **cultures** organisms hunt, **debridement** dead tissue clears, **flaps** groins cover, **amputation** unsalvageable last) with **hunts** (**scans** fluid collects, **bloods** markers rise) seeks; **remove** (infected plastic out) clears. Grafts infect.
steps.say: Draining sinuses with fever warn prosthetic infection for excision with clean-plane rerouting while vein resists better, hunted by cultures with scans. Removal clears.

steps.tx: **Bulge** (**pseudoaneurysm** pulsatile scars swell, **anastomotic** suture lines weaken, **duplex** yin-yang proves, **repair** interposition grafts fix, **rupture** expanding pain warns, **embolus** downstream clots shower, **femoral** groins frequent, **follow** yearly feels) with **feels** (**pulses** scars throb, **bruits** scars hum) finds; **fix** (sacs excised) steadies. Scars bulge.
steps.say: Pulsatile scars name anastomotic pseudoaneurysms proved by duplex yin-yang flow for interposition repair before rupture or emboli, watched yearly. Scars throb.

steps.tx: **After** (**rejection** biopsies prove fevers, **infection** mimics rejection closely, **lymphocele** lymph collects compress, **ureteric** leaks stent drain, **PTLD** nodes warn heavy suppression, **skin** cancers screen yearly, **creatinine** rises flag early, **follow** lifelong never discharges) with **watches** (**bloods** drug levels tracks, **scans** collects finds) follows; **balance** (suppression versus infection) treads. Follow-up lasts.
steps.say: Fever with graft pain earns biopsy separating rejection from infection while lymphoceles drain and nodes warn PTLD, balanced lifelong with drug levels. Watches balance.
